description: Remove ONE field rule of a form, by its rule_id from list_field_rules: the fields it showed, hid or filled in go back to how the form shows them without it. Asked to stop showing, hiding or filling a field «when…», find the rule in list_field_rules and remove that one — never several for one request. A rule cannot be changed: remove it and make it again (set_field_visibility_rule).
name: delete_field_rule
